about: Post HTML → PostDoc (appendix A 27-32 and the fields the current parser drops). file is a synthetic page; request is what was asked for; expect lists what the parse must yield (a field not listed is not checked here); outcome is a refusal. lines are the body's text lines in order (a line may hold a newline inside one paragraph block). Picture numbers (images <post> N), link host/link_id, own-money cards, product and blogNo fields are implemented and asserted by test_body.py; these are current parser contracts.

facts: Text and markup keep document order (앞중간뒤 is 앞중간뒤, not 앞뒤중간).
data-lazy-src is the real picture; src is a blurred placeholder; each picture of a group keeps its own caption.
Every picture, sticker and card cover is numbered in document order, so images <post> N names one exactly; a sticker can be a disclosure banner the text never states.
An implicitly closed <td> still makes its own cell; a table row is cells joined by ' | '.
A video module with only a thumbnail keeps url null (a thumbnail is not the video); an oembed is an embed, not called a video.
A known family holding nothing (an empty text paragraph) is a spacer and counts as full.

A link's host and link_id travel with it: mkt.shopping.naver.com/link/<id> (a seller's marketing link), link.coupang.com/a/<id>, naver.me/<code>; other hosts carry no id. Page anchors (#top) are not links.
The page's viewer identifiers (userId, userIdNo, baUserKey) never reach the record; userId only refreshes the session.

The title loses Naver's ' : 네이버 블로그' suffix; tags are split on commas and trimmed; page variables are read in the forms pages use (P2): single or double quotes (var blogNo = '123456'), numbers (var gnCategoryNo = 5) and the comparison var isBuyWithMyOwnMoneyPost = 'false' === 'true' (read as its boolean result).
A place card (placesMap, P2 shape) carries a static map picture and the place's name and address in its link data; the map picture is numbered as kind map.
An unfamiliar family keeps its text, pictures and links and counts as partial.
A component holding another component with a module (a video inside a text block) is partial, and what its rule missed is salvaged as [media: …].
A map with neither module data nor text is partial, not a spacer.
An empty gsTagName is a post with no tags ([]), not unknown.

A picture hosted outside Naver (P6: a review-campaign platform's blog_traffic.php banner) is numbered and named with its host: it cannot be saved through the read surface, and the host itself can be the signal.
An empty se-main-container beside a legacy container is not SmartEditor: the container is chosen by finding components, not by an attribute.

An open

is closed by the next

even under an inline ; a stray is ignored.
Legacy table cells are separated (A B), not run together (AB).
A legacy picture is numbered in place too.

pages.fact: Neither container (a maintenance page, a redesign): drift.
A legacy container with nothing extractable: drift.
No gsTagName at all: tags unknown (not 'no tags').
Same post number, different blog id: the page names the canonical blog (a domain address).
A page for another post number is refused: mixing two posts is worse than failing.

pages.fact: Naver's 내돈내산 인증 card (a se-custom component holding not_sponsored_component, P6): a purchase or visit Naver recorded (shopping order, reservation, receipt, payment — attachment_type buy_with_my_own_money_*) that the writer attached. It is what search --own-money matches; the page variable isBuyWithMyOwnMoneyPost stays false beside it, so it is not the signal.

deep.fact: Markup nests deeper than Python's stack: parsing, finding and text extraction are iterative.
